# Vendored third-party assets

Copied in so the console runs entirely offline. None of it is our work; the licences below
are the upstream ones, and the full licence texts should travel with these files.

- `virtualsky/` — VirtualSky and its data files (`stars.json`, `lines_latin.json`,
  `boundaries.json`, `galaxy.json`, `showers.json`, `lang/`, `stuquery.js`,
  `virtualsky-planets.js`). Stuart Lowe / Las Cumbres Observatory, MIT licence.
  https://github.com/slowe/VirtualSky
- `fonts/ibm-plex-mono-*.woff2` — IBM Plex Mono, IBM, SIL Open Font Licence 1.1.
  https://github.com/IBM/plex
- `fonts/barlow-condensed-*.woff2` — Barlow Condensed, Jeremy Tribby, SIL Open Font
  Licence 1.1. https://github.com/jpt/barlow

The OFL requires its text and the copyright notice to accompany the font files, so
`LICENSE` files still need adding here — a gap inherited from where this app was copied
from, not something introduced by the copy.
